## 6. Purchase of goods by obtaining bids  
In all other cases purchases may be made by following the standard  
method of obtaining bids in:  
- (i) Advertised Tender Enquiry
- (iii) Two-Stage Bidding
- (v)
- Electronic Reverse Auctions
